newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos says finds new Cooper gas field.
newsitem.headline: Santos says finds new Cooper gas field.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Wednesday it had found a new gas field in the South Australian section of the Cooper/Eromanga basins with gas flows from two separate formations.

The Goyder 2 exploration well located on the south eastern flank of the Allunga trough had flowed gas at 154,300 cubic metres per day and condensate at 43 cubic metres or 477 barrels per day, Santos said.
A second drill stem test conducted over a 28 metre interval had flowed gas at 159,400 cubic metres per day and condensate at 76 cubic metres per day.

"Goyder 2, which has a good flow rates, is also the second gas field discovery in the South Australian section of the Cooper/Eromana Basins for 1997," Santos' South Australian Manager Mike Hannell said in a statement.
"Because of the high liquids content the company plans to fast track development of this field," Hannell said.
"A number of nearby prospects have been upgraded as a result of this successful well."

Santos owns 59.75 percent of the Goyder 2 well, with Boral Energy owning 13.19 percent, Exxon Corp unit Delhi Petroleum owning 20.21 percent and Clyde Petroleum Plc's Crusader Resources owning 4.75 percent.
